verdict.rationale: Rippling documents bulk operations only within benefits: uploading a carrier EOI file that matches decisions to employees and adjusts payroll deductions in bulk, and auto-approving dependents and routing EOI in bulk. Supergroup rules also manage app permissions for groups of users. There is no evidence of general-purpose bulk editing across employees or records, nor of bulk operations driven by an API, CLI, or AI. Missing for 10: general bulk edit/actions across arbitrary records, bulk API or CLI endpoints for AI-driven workflows, AI-initiated bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
